component.name: Imladris
component.summary: Scientific notebook studio and Markdown editor

description.p: Imladris is a native Linux polyglot document studio and scientific Markdown editor built with Vala, GTK4, Libadwaita, GtkSourceView 5, and WebKitGTK 6.0. Featuring an adaptive ribbon interface, Imladris provides a distraction-free writing environment for technical authors, data scientists, and researchers.
Whether editing Quarto research reports, R Markdown statistical documents, or Jupyter notebooks, Imladris renders mathematical formulas, tables, and charts in real time.

ul.li: Categorized Launch Modal: 9 creation targets across multi-file projects (Standard and Sandboxed) and standalone simple files
Sandbox Dependency Engine: Isolated environments with renv for R and venv for Python
The .mallorn Exchange Format: 1:1 bidirectional compatibility with RStudio projects and portable single-file bundles
OpenDocument Export Pipeline: Headless export to ODT and ODP presentations
Adaptive Modern Ribbon: High-density GTK4 and Libadwaita tabs for Home, Insert, Computation, Publish, and View with linked controls and quick collapse (Ctrl+F1)
Real-Time Live Preview: WebKitGTK 6.0 preview with KaTeX mathematics, Mermaid diagrams, and syntax highlighting
Dual AI Co-Author: In-editor writing assistant with support for local offline models and cloud LLMs
Model Context Protocol (MCP): Built-in MCP server integration for agentic document analysis and data retrieval

description.p: Note: This application is independently developed and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Posit, RStudio, or Project Jupyter.

description.p: Release v0.9.0 introduces the Automated micromamba Data Science Toolchain Manager and 4-tier runtime resolution hierarchy (Project Sandbox → Managed Global Toolchain → Host Flatpak Spawn → Host Native). Provides one-click automated installation of R 4.4 with dev compilers, IRkernel, pre-compiled tidyverse, Python 3.12 with uv, and Quarto CLI into user storage ($XDG_DATA_HOME/imladris/toolchains/) with zero root permissions and zero host compilation errors. Enables completely self-contained execution on clean Linux installations inside Flatpak containers.

Release v0.8.0 introduces transparent host R interpreter discovery and execution support inside Flatpak sandboxes via the flatpak-spawn host portal, shared host-sandbox cache directory (~/.cache/imladris) for graphics plots and temporary scripts, and real-time package compilation log streaming to the interactive console pane.

Release v0.7.0 brings the complete 11-pillar expansion, modernized Libadwaita Ribbon menu with 5 consolidated high-density tabs and collapsible deck (Ctrl+F1), appearance theming with GNOME default accent colors, and a vastly expanded AI Assistant subsystem: First-class support for Google Gemini (AI Studio and Google OAuth token), Claude (Anthropic Messages API with thinking blocks), OpenAI (GPT-4o, o1, o3-mini), Cursor API compatibility, NVIDIA NIM cloud endpoints, DeepSeek (including DeepSeek-R1 reasoning stream extraction), Kimi (Moonshot AI), Qwen (Alibaba DashScope), Ollama, and LM Studio local server with persistent user credentials; clean launch modal with clean UI labels, context-aware ribbon state machine, RStudio-style package installer for CRAN and PyPI, interactive R and Python persistent consoles with inline chunk output cards and plot rendering, automatic pwd synchronization, sandboxed project engine with RStudio and Jupyter export, 1:1 DCF parity for .mallorn bundles, and headless ODT/ODP pipeline.

Release v0.6.0 introduces the 6 core pillars: Categorized creation pop-up dialog with 9 creation targets, sandboxed vs standard project engines (renv and venv isolation), the 1:1 RStudio-compatible .mallorn exchange format, and comprehensive ODT and ODP OpenDocument export pipelines.
Release v0.5.1 standardizes the canonical Flatpak and Freedesktop Application ID to io.github.Antux912012.Imladris and includes the Phase 1.1.3 RStudio 4-Quadrant Drag-and-Drop Docking System.

Release v0.5.0 introduces dynamic UI morphing (GNOME Apostrophe distraction-free mode and RStudio 4-quadrant workbench), full multi-format adapters (.md, .qmd, .rmd, .ipynb), atomic crash recovery with shadow buffer caching, and 5 interactive Smart Ribbon popovers.
Release v0.4.0 with AI co-authoring assistance, polyglot auto-completion, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integration.
Release v0.3.0 featuring WebKitGTK 6.0 live preview, KaTeX math rendering, and multi-format export.
